task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Issue imperial edict declaring epidemic emergency, authorize extraordinary quarantine and relief measures, and mobilize treasury reserves
Coordinate the central administrative response: marshal physicians, requisition medicine stores, and synchronize ministry actions across the capital
Enforce city-gate quarantine, household registration checks, and isolation of afflicted wards in their respective major cities; report daily mortality and contagion figures to the capital
Manage logistics: stockpile and dispatch grain, medicinal herbs, and medical personnel; maintain roads between cities and operate relief granaries for displaced populations
